Thus, the ability of MRI to accurately estimate muscle volume is highly dependent on the number of serial images obtained along the longitudinal axis of a given muscle. Although no studies have validated MRI-derived measures of muscle volume over the course of a longitudinal exercise study, it seems reasonable to conclude that its precision would be similar to single-point analysis.
